name: Tengenjibashi Rei
source:
Type: human
Skills: exorcising ayakashi
Occupation: onmyoji
Location: Shinjuku

[i]"Because I'm an onmyoji... It's my job to exorcise ayakashi."[/i]

A young man who comes a strict family background, making a living as an onmyoji in the back alleys of Tokyo. He has the power to seal ayakashi and even destroy them if absolutely necessary.

He takes things at his own pace while avoiding anything he deems too flashy, completely unashamed of his openness to sexual relationships. Times when he is deep in contemplation and scheming, his expression rarely reveals what he is truly thinking. 

Having an aversion to doing tedious work, he leaves the house chores to Basara and prefers to pass the time painting on sliding screens.

[Edited from [url=https://twitter.com/i/events/1495144875670573056]Moonchime Localization[/url]]
